from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2d45495e.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    src = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 0)]
    dst = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in src), max(r for r, c in src)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in src), max(c for r, c in src)
    dr0, dr1 = min(r for r, c in dst), max(r for r, c in dst)
    dc0, dc1 = min(c for r, c in dst), max(c for r, c in dst)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(dr1 - dr0 + 1):
        for c in range(dc1 - dc0 + 1):
            out[dr0 + r][dc0 + c] = grid[r0 + r][c1 - c]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
ns={}; exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),ns)
demo=[[2]*12 for _ in range(12)]
pat=[[1,3,3,1],[1,1,3,1],[1,3,3,3],[1,1,1,1]]
for i,row in enumerate(pat): demo[1+i][1:5]=row
for r in range(7,11): demo[r][4:8]=[0]*4
result=ns['transform'](demo)
expected=[[2]*12 for _ in range(12)]
for i,row in enumerate(pat): expected[1+i][1:5]=row
op=[[1,3,3,1],[1,3,1,1],[3,3,3,1],[1,1,1,1]]
for i,row in enumerate(op): expected[7+i][4:8]=row
print(result==expected)
test=[[8]*12 for _ in range(12)]
for i,row in enumerate([[1,1,1,2],[1,1,2,1],[1,2,2,2]]): test[1+i][1:5]=row
for r in range(9,12): test[r][2:6]=[0]*4
answer=ns['transform'](test)
print(answer[9:12])
